extracted.intended_audience: psychology researchers, prospective and current peer reviewers and editors (APA journal community)
extracted.subtask_short: conducting peer review for psychology journals
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and standards for performing peer review of manuscripts in psychology (APA journals), including training, reporting standards, recognition, and pathways to editorial roles. Focuses on procedures, ethical policies, and discipline-specific reporting guidelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Core purpose of peer review
rubrics_metrics.description: "Positive peer reviews contribute to increased funding opportunities, academic advancement and a good reputation."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Frames peer review as activity that supports scientific quality and has career and funding implications; reviewers should be aware of the professional impact of their work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best practices for co-reviewing with senior mentors
rubrics_metrics.description: Best practices for co-reviewing manuscripts with senior mentors
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourages use of structured co-review practices (e.g., clear attribution of trainee contributions, mentor oversight); page lists this as a resource area though specific practices are provided in linked guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow step-by-step review procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Step-by-step guidance on conducting peer reviews
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use a systematic review workflow provided by APA resources (e.g., how to read a manuscript, assess methods/results, provide constructive feedback); implies following checklists and structured review stages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Participate in reviewer mentorship programs
rubrics_metrics.description: Reviewer mentorship programs across APA journals
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Join journal mentorship programs to develop reviewing skills and learn editorial expectations; used as a mechanism to improve review quality and consistency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Be familiar with emerging review formats (e.g., registered reports)
rubrics_metrics.description: Editor conversations about emerging review formats like registered reports
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewers should understand alternative formats (registered reports, etc.) and how review criteria differ for them; consult editor discussions and guidance on format-specific expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Record and claim reviewer recognition
rubrics_metrics.description: Web of Science Reviewer Recognition Service enables reviewers to maintain verified records for promotions and funding applications
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use recognition services to document reviewing activity for career advancement; maintain verified records tied to institutions and funding/ promotion dossiers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use Publons (instant reviewer recognition)
rubrics_metrics.description: Publons service provides instant recognition for peer review contributions
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Claim reviews on Publons or equivalent platforms to demonstrate service; follow journal policies on what can be publicly recorded.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adhere to JARS (Journal Article Reporting Standards)
rubrics_metrics.description: JARS (Journal Article Reporting Standards) — guidelines for authors, reviewers, and editors to enhance scientific rigor
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewers should apply JARS to assess completeness and transparency of reporting; JARS aims to improve reproducibility and methodological clarity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow NSF Grant Proposal Guide principles where relevant
rubrics_metrics.description: NSF Grant Proposal Guide — NSF's proposal and award process policies
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When reviewing material relevant to NSF-funded research or proposals, be mindful of NSF reporting and policy expectations referenced by APA.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comply with NIH Peer Review Policies
rubrics_metrics.description: NIH Peer Review Policies — regulations governing peer review integrity, conflicts of interest, and appeals
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewers must follow NIH rules on conflicts of interest, confidentiality, appeals, and integrity when applicable to reviewed content or processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Respect OMB Information Quality Bulletin requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: OMB Information Quality Bulletin — requires federal agencies to peer review important scientific information
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognize federal guidance on quality standards for scientific information that may affect evaluations of government-affiliated research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use JARS-Quant for quantitative research reporting
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply JARS-Quant checklists to evaluate statistical reporting, methods detail, measurement, analytical transparency, and reproducibility for quantitative studies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use JARS-Qual for qualitative research reporting
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply JARS-Qual to assess sampling, data collection, analytic approach, reflexivity, and adequacy of evidence in qualitative manuscripts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use MARS for meta-analytic reporting
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess meta-analyses using MARS criteria: search strategy transparency, inclusion/exclusion criteria, effect-size computation, heterogeneity assessment, and bias analyses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Seek reviewer opportunities and listings
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use APA-maintained listings to find review assignments; staying active improves reviewer experience and availability for journals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pursue editorial career pathways
rubrics_metrics.description: Career pathway information for becoming a journal editor
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow APA resources on steps to editorial roles (service, mentorship, demonstrated reviewing quality); editors should have training and familiarity with reviewing standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consult resources on manuscript review best practices and responsibilities
rubrics_metrics.description: Resources on manuscript review best practices and common reviewer responsibilities
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewers should understand expected responsibilities (timeliness, confidentiality, constructive feedback, conflict disclosure) and consult APA best-practice materials to align reviews with professional norms.
